summary: test(functional-tests): add v2 pairing specs and a Marionette harness
description:
Because:
- The v2 pairing flow had no end-to-end coverage.
- The v2 supplicant runs real chrome commands, so it cannot be a Playwright page.

This commit:
- Adds pairingFlowV2Android, driving a Marionette authority and a real Fenix
  supplicant with nothing stubbed.
- Adds pairingFlowV2, driving both halves over Marionette and standing in only
  for the oauth_login that desktop chrome does not implement.
- Adds a marionetteSupplicant fixture and a v2-capable Firefox resolver.
- Extends pairChoice with v2 version negotiation.
